period_note: PARTIAL / MIXED-CONFIDENCE quarter. This bank's own real Q3 2020 interim financial statement PDF exists and was downloaded, but its text layer is badly corrupted (looks like an OCR pass over a scanned copy: e.g. 'Seotembet 2420' for 'September 2020', digits broken up with spurious spaces and stray letters substituted for digits). Two figures survived legible and unambiguous even amid the noise -- Total assets (112,374,166,585, only spurious spacing, no character substitution) and NAV per share (15.94, clean) -- and are recorded here with normal confidence. Every other balance-sheet line (equity, deposits, loans, investments, off-balance-sheet) could only be reconstructed by assuming specific OCR digit-substitutions and back-solving from component sums; that reconstruction was attempted but is NOT reported here because it depends on an unverified assumption about which digit was misread, which would misrepresent an estimate as a reported figure -- recorded as a gap instead, per the 'never fabricate' rule. INCOME STATEMENT for this quarter is therefore taken instead from the FY2020 annual report's own retrospective 'Quarterly Performance' table (discrete Q3,2020 column) -- note this table's Q2,2020 column was already found to diverge from the contemporaneous interim filing on the tax/net-profit line only (see 2020_Q2.json), so the same provenance caveat applies here even though no contemporaneous Q3 interim P&L could be checked against it this time. non_interest_and_investment_income again bundles investment income (the annual-table convention), unlike non_interest_income used in the Q1/Q2 2020 files above.
